settings.text: UV Gel Nail Wraps are pre-shaped gel polish strips that stick to your nails. Unlike regular gel polish, these are no-mess. Simply apply the strips, cure with our UV lamp, and you’ll have a high quality manicure.

settings.title: UP TO TWO WEEKS FLAWLESS SHINE
settings.subtitle: Designed to provide a durable finish with a glossy shine that can last up to two weeks. Add a gel top coat for even longer lasting shine!

settings.title: FITS EVERY NAIL
settings.subtitle: Each box contains multiple sizes to accommodate different nail widths and lengths. If a strip is slightly larger than your nail, it can be trimmed with nail scissors or clippers to fit more accurately. If a strip is slightly smaller than your nail, you can stretch it to fit more accurately.

settings.title: CURES IN SECONDS
settings.subtitle: Experience quick and convenient nail care with our Glam Gel Nail nail strips. Cure in just 60-120 seconds under a UV or LED lamp for instant, long-lasting shine and durability.

settings.title: DAMAGE FREE REMOVAL
settings.subtitle: Enjoy damage-free removal with our Glam Gel Nail strips. Designed for using a gentle oil-based removal, our strips ensure a stress-free experience without compromising your natural nail health.

settings.title: How long will my manicure last?
settings.content: Your mani should last 10-14 days. Consider using a topcoat to extend its longevity!

settings.title: How often do you launch new designs?
settings.content: We are constantly working on new designs. Have a suggestion? Feel free to share it with us!

settings.title: Can I reuse my gel nail strips?
settings.content: Unfortunately, once applied to your nails, the gel nail strips cannot be reused.

settings.title: How long should I cure?
settings.content: Only 60 seconds. If you don’t have a UV lamp, you can order your Glam Gel Nail UV Lamp here.

settings.title: When will you ship my order?
settings.content: Your order will typically ship within 1-2 business days.

settings.title: Can I cancel or modify my order?
settings.content: Unfortunately we cannot modify or cancel an order after it has been placed. Our team is committed to swiftly processing and delivering your orders, and any alterations would hinder this efficiency.

settings.title: How do I remove them?
settings.content: Apply oil to the edges and cuticles of your nails. Wedge the wooden stick provided in our nail kit under the nail wrap and gently lift up.

settings.title: Can I use oils or lotions on my hands while wearing gel nail strips?
settings.content: Lotions are okay, but for longevity we recommend avoiding oils and oil-based lotions on your hands while wearing Glam Gel Nails. Oils can break down the adhesive, which may cause your nails to lift or separate from your natural nails.
